correctness.rationale: Finite complete numerical-semigroup tree to genus 27, using unique-parent Frobenius insertion and all effective-generator removals, yields exactly 3220696 sources and matches published genus counts. The additive ideal square is generated by products of positive minimal generators; shortest-path Apéry data give exact genus and Frobenius. Every nonsymmetric source in the complete range fails square symmetry. Independent Python set enumeration confirms genera through 17; the reference genus-41 witness checked separately. Full executable sources and actual output logs included.

value.rationale: The first genus µ at which symmetry emerges under ideal squaring is natural and motivated by the 2026 genus-41 first example; a complete exact exclusion through genus 27 across 3,220,696 structures gives a substantive cutoff µ≥28, removing a large interval of cases rather than arbitrary examples. The result does not require an infinite theorem or paper-sized downstream consequence.
